test_series_rank_basic: test the Series.rank() method with default average tie-breaking on a numeric series
test_series_rank_tie_methods: test the Series.rank() method with average, min, max, first, and dense tie-breaking methods
test_series_rank_categorical: test the Series.rank() method on ordered and unordered categorical series
test_series_rank_nullable_dtypes: test the Series.rank() method on nullable integer and float dtypes like Int64 and Float64
test_series_rank_pct: test the Series.rank() method with pct=True to compute percentage-based rankings
test_series_rank_ascending_descending: test the Series.rank() method with ascending=False for descending order ranking
test_series_rank_na_option: test the Series.rank() method with na_option set to keep, top, or bottom for NaN handling
test_series_rank_infs_nans: test the Series.rank() method on series containing positive and negative infinity values with NaN
test_series_rank_dense_pct: test the Series.rank() method with method=dense and pct=True for dense percentage rankings
test_series_rank_min_max_avg_first_pct: test the Series.rank() method with min, max, average, and first methods combined with pct=True
